Follow AGENTS.md, docs/SPEC.md and OPERATIONS.md. Preserve frozen training, selection and test boundaries. Keep deterministic document-ID tie breaks and grouped analysis. Never fill missing measurements with zero. Hash and verify complete model/index bundles. Public requests cannot load arbitrary models or invoke release actions. No secret, visitor query text, capability or large model weight belongs in Git. Every substantive change needs the relevant independent tests and retained execution evidence before completion claims.
